titlestmt.titleproper: David Rockefeller papers, Associates, Christopher Kennan papers
A Guide to the David Rockefeller papers, Associates, Christopher Kennan papers FA1192

profiledesc.creation: This finding aid was produced using ArchivesSpace on 2026-09-02 19:58:27 UTC.

did.unittitle: David Rockefeller papers, Associates, Christopher Kennan papers

physdesc.extent: 24 standard record storage boxes and 1 half-letter document box

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research in accordance with the terms of donation from the David Rockefeller Estate, January 2019. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Intellectually arranged in series by subject/topic. Records are maintained in original order, as received.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Christopher Kennan papers primarily document David Rockefeller's activities and interests in the field of international affairs, including but not necessarily limited to the Americas Society, the Council of the Americas, Caribbean/Central American Action, the Council of the Americas, the Council on Foreign Relations, New York City Partnership, and the Trilateral Commmission.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: The Christopher Kennan files were transferred to Rockefeller Archive Center in 2012 as Accession 2012:029, and donated to RAC by the David Rockefeller estate in 2019.
